_comment: Extra permissions the deploy user needs to APPLY the directory-index rewrite.
Attach to IAM user 'github-actions' in the frontend account 176202287053, then
re-run the 'Apply CloudFront rewrite' workflow. Without this it can sync S3 and
invalidate, but not read or update a distribution, so the workflow stops at its
CloudFront Functions are account-global and have no per-distribution ARN, so the
function statement cannot be scoped to a resource; it is narrowed by action
instead. The distribution statement IS scoped - add each distribution ARN you
intend to fix rather than widening it to *.
Delete this policy once the rewrite is applied; it is only needed for that
one-shot change, not for day-to-day deploys.
